changes.note: AT&T, Kodak, and International Paper replaced by Pfizer, AIG, and Verizon.
SBC Communications renamed AT&T Inc. after acquiring AT&T Corp.
Altria and Honeywell replaced by Chevron and Bank of America.
Kraft Foods added after AIG was removed.
General Motors and Citigroup replaced by Travelers and Cisco.
Kraft Foods replaced by UnitedHealth Group.
Alcoa, Bank of America, and Hewlett-Packard replaced by Goldman Sachs, Visa, and Nike.
DuPont merged into DowDuPont; DWDP became the index member.
General Electric replaced by Walgreens Boots Alliance.
DowDuPont split; Dow Inc. became the index member.
United Technologies renamed Raytheon Technologies after separating from Carrier and Otis.
Exxon Mobil, Pfizer, and Raytheon replaced by Salesforce, Amgen, and Honeywell.
Walgreens Boots Alliance replaced by Amazon.
Intel and Dow replaced by Nvidia and Sherwin-Williams.
Verizon replaced by Alphabet; Honeywell renamed Honeywell Technologies after its aerospace spinoff.
